::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 156,458 people lived in County Kerry, up 5.9% on 2016. It had the 10th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 53% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Kerry was €1,182, the 15th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
